intents.goal: Our e-mails should greet people by their first name. Split each person's name into a first name and a last name, and greet them by first name.
intents.acceptance: A migration adds first_name and last_name to every stored {{collection}} record, greeting() uses the first name, and npm test passes.
intents.constraints: Deploys are rolling and the database already has real data; see docs/deploy.md.
